items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I’ve done so many motion pictures with all composers, from Michel Legrand, you name them.

ctx.x: It must have been a bit of an adjustment.

Yeah. After you say well what am I doing here. I mean if I’m doing this I must participate in what is expected. And I’ve done so many motion pictures with all composers, from Michel Legrand, you name them. Which, thank God, you know “Man with the Golden Arm” with Elmer Bernstein, it goes on and on, especially with Hank, all the things we’ve done, Mancini you know. I really hadn’t thought about this in a long time to be honest with you.
How many years did you put into the studio?
